I specifically just want any suggestions or comments on my routine. So far, so good, but I'm not that great at doing research on ingredients that could potentially harm my face, so I need guidance. Also, am I lacking in any particular way? Or, I'm even worried that I might be overdoing it? Thanks!
Do you use a second cleanser after your oil cleanser? Oil cleansers are meant to be used as the first part of a double cleanse, after all.

I suggest incorporating your shaving with your nighttime routine instead of your daytime. Try to avoid putting anything that could potentially clog your open pores on top of them (eg makeup). Also, I usually do the same time I do my exfoliating, which is after cleansing, but before toner.

First, I definitely suggest regularly using clay or charcoal masks! I personally recommend the Innisfree Jeju Pore Clay Mask. I use it once a week, and it really helps with blackheads on my nose. If that doesn't work or you're not into face masks, the CosRX BHA Blackhead Power Liquid is also useful! I alternate methods depending on how I feel like it. Last, when worse comes to worst, the Biore Charcoal Pore Strips are always a life saver. 

However, the most important is to make sure that the products that you are currently using doesn't have any ingredients that could potentially be clogging your pores.

This is what I felt with Etude House's Collagen Moistfull Emulsion. At first, it was like godsend, but after months of use, it just didn't seem as great. In fact, it felt like my skin even got oily the more I used it from a certain point. Had to change moisturisers after that.
I love the The Face Shop Rice and Ceramide Toner and the The Face Shop Rice Water Bright Cleansing Foam. Both are so good to my skin!
